prompt: Challenge C022-CH3: We want to add a water-balance module so farmers can plan irrigation scheduling, but none of our staff understands evapotranspiration modell

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Reference evapotranspiration is calculated using the FAO Penman-Monteith method, which requires systematic handling of meteorological input data under Pannonian lowland conditions.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-10778","field":"title","quote":"FAO-PM evapotranspiration estimates to systematic biases in input climate variables"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-10775","field":"keywords","quote":"referentna evapotranspiracija FAO Penman-Monteith"}]},{"text":"Soil water balance modelling at field parcel scale connects reference evapotranspiration estimates with soil moisture measurements and crop water requirements for irrigation scheduling decisions.","sources":[{"id":"R1047","field":"bio","quote":"modeliranjem vodnog bilansa na nivou parcele, procenom referentne evapotranspiracije"},{"id":"R1047","field":"keywords","quote":"soil water balance irrigation scheduling field water deficit"}]},{"text":"Field validation of irrigation scheduling systems requires integration of soil moisture sensor networks with reference evapotranspiration calculations and comparison against measured depletion dynamics over a complete growing season.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-06984","field":"abstract","quote":"soil moisture sensors were evaluated over one full sugar beet growing season tracking depletion dynamics"},{"id":"R1047","field":"bio","quote":"Laboratorija raspolaže oprema za merenje vlažnosti zemljišta FDR sonde automatskim meteorološkim stanicama"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher has direct expertise in FAO Penman-Monteith implementation for Pannonian conditions [SYN-PUB-10775], published sensitivity analysis of this method under local climate uncertainty [SYN-PUB-10778], and practical experience coupling soil moisture measurements with irrigation scheduling [SYN-PUB-06984], matching all core requirements of the water-balance calculation engine."}
